name: Midnight Roots | 200mg Full Moon Chocolate | Thin Mint Dark Chocolate
description:
Thin Mint Cookie Dark Chocolate Midnight Full moon.
Handcrafted Artisan dark chocolate at 74% caco Thin Mint dark chocolate, gives you that memorable taste you got from the cookie we all know and love, but in a delicious full moon size chocolate that melts in your mouth, and is consistently potent.
